modes.advice: Advice only: it reads and explains, and sends the printer nothing.
modes.ask: Ask every time: every step that changes something waits for your yes.
modes.balanced: Balanced: it moves, homes, cools and adjusts by itself, and asks before it heats, pushes filament, runs a macro or changes a calibration.
modes.free: Hands-on: it does everything inside the safety limits by itself, and asks only before it ends a print early.
modes.open: No approvals: it never stops to ask. The safety limits still hold, and a print still starts from Confirm Print.

body.note: Blank fields inherit the chosen preset. Names and choices match OrcaSlicer's own option table; the engine applies its own limits when it slices.

options.label: Seam gap
options.tip: Stops the loop this short of its start so the seam doesn't bulge.

options.label: Scarf joint seam
options.tip: Ramps the seam over a distance instead of a single spot.

options.label: Resolution
options.tip: Smallest detail kept when outlines are simplified.

options.label: Wall generator
options.tip: Arachne varies line width for thin features.

options.label: Only one wall on top surfaces
Bridge flow ratio
options.tip: Above 1 squeezes more plastic into bridges.

options.label: Minimum sparse infill area
options.tip: Smaller pockets are filled solid instead.

options.label: Combine infill
options.tip: Prints sparse infill every few layers, thicker, to save time.

options.label: Small perimeters
options.tip: A number in mm/s, or a percentage of the outer wall speed, like 50%.

options.label: Overhang 10–25%
options.tip: 0 means no slowdown for this band.

options.label: Default jerk
options.tip: On Klipper printers the engine writes this as square corner velocity.

options.label: Prime tower
options.tip: Needed for clean colour changes on a tool changer; switch off only for single-head prints.

options.label: Ooze prevention
options.tip: Drops idle heads' temperature while another head prints.

options.label: Label objects for skipping
options.tip: Lets you skip one object mid-print from the Control tab.

presets.about: A printing printer jams 10 minutes in. Watch the fleet card turn red, the print fail in history, and any "print failed" rule fire.
presets.name: Jam mid-print

presets.about: One printer stops answering for 15 minutes. Its card keeps its last report, labelled stale; commands to it fail in words; then it comes back.
presets.name: Network drop

presets.about: Someone loads the wrong colour on the active toolhead of a running print. The filament-mismatch rule fires, and Confirm Print blocks the next start.
presets.name: Bad filament swap

presets.about: A printer racks up 60 print hours. Maintenance counts them itself and the nozzle check goes overdue - the fleet alert and any maintenance rule follow.
presets.name: Maintenance goes overdue

presets.about: A runout, a jam, a network drop and a heater fault across the farm over an hour - the farm-scale version, to see everything react at once.
